---
title: "Frameworks and guidance for inclusive research"
include-after-body:
  text: '<script src="repo.js"></script>'
---

Established frameworks, toolkits and guidance to help ICH researchers embed race equity and inclusion across the research cycle, from the funding application to reporting. Filter by research stage or department, or search by keyword. To see what ICH colleagues are already doing, visit [ICH examples](examples.qmd).

These resources were not developed by the ICH Race Equity Group. Most are drawn from the MRC page [Community resources to support diversity and inclusion in research](https://www.ukri.org/about-us/mrc/our-policies-and-standards/embedding-diversity-in-research-design/community-resources-to-support-diversity-and-inclusion-in-research). Where advice conflicts with UKRI or MRC policy, follow UKRI and MRC policy.

Resources without a department tag are relevant across ICH. [Download the full list as a spreadsheet](data/resources.csv).
